globalSettings.s_alexa-account.title: Amazon Alexa account
globalSettings.s_alexa-account.descripti: Alexa accounts are managed in the External systems → Brokers tab.
globalSettings.s_alexa-proxy-login.title: Interactive login (proxy)
globalSettings.s_alexa-proxy-login.descr: The "Login to Amazon" button in onboarding opens a local proxy that captures the cookie after you complete the real Amazon login (incl. 2FA). Because Amazon URLs are rewritten to this exact host:port, it must be a directly-reachable address — leave the host blank to auto-detect the server IP, and make sure the port is reachable from the browser you log in from.
connection.s_alexa-account.title: Amazon Alexa account
connection.s_alexa-account.description: Link an Amazon account via the unofficial Alexa client. Supply a captured cookie OR a refresh token. NOTE: this is an unofficial integration — Amazon can change or break it without notice, and it may violate Amazon ToS. State is polled, not pushed.
connection.s_alexa-account.cookie.label: Cookie blob (from proxy login)
globalSettings.s_alexa-speak.title: Speak on Echo
globalSettings.s_alexa-speak.description: Sign in on the Speak on Echo page, pick the devices, and use them as a notification target. The text is the rule template, read aloud.
